question: ‘Higher Education Leadership Development Programme for Administrator’ is a programme launched by which Union Ministry?

options.text: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship

solution:
The correct answer is __**Ministry of Human Resource Development**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The "Higher Education Leadership Development Programme for Administrators" is a joint initiative launched by the University Grants Commission (UGC) and the UK India Education and Research Initiative (UKIERI).
 
• Launched in: **2020**
 
• Objective: To enhance the leadership capabilities of mid and senior-level academic administrators in Indian universities.
 
• Focus: Equipping administrators with the knowledge, skills, and behaviors necessary to drive systemic change and improvement within their institutions.
 
• Implementation: Delivered by Advance HE, a leading UK-based organization specializing in higher education enhancement.
 
• Target Audience: Joint/Deputy/Assistant Registrars and Registrars in Indian Universities.
 
• Methodology: A blended learning approach, combining online training modules with facilitated group discussions, action learning sets, and peer-to-peer learning.
 
• Improved leadership capacity among university administrators.
 
• Enhanced institutional effectiveness and quality.
 
• Strengthened collaboration between Indian and UK higher education institutions.
 
• **Note: The current Chairman of the UGC is Jagadesh Kumar.**
